panels.title: RPM
panels.description: Fan rotation speed in revolutions per minute, sent as part of each high-rate vibration batch (once per BATCH_INTERVAL_MS).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "rpm")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 30s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Vibration SNR
panels.description: SNR at the fan's rotational frequency (1X), computed every batch (see #37/#38/#39). Rises before crossing the alert threshold - useful for spotting a developing fault early, not just a confirmed one.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vibration")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "snr")

panels.title: Anomaly Log
panels.description: Discrete alert events - fired when Vibration SNR crosses the calibrated threshold (see #39/#40).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alert")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

title: Vigilo - Sensor Node Telemetry
description: RPM, continuous vibration SNR, and anomaly log from the Vigilo ESP32 sensor node, via MQTT and InfluxDB. Full FFT analysis runs separately on high-rate batches (see #36).
